title: NVIDIA DGX Spark Arrives for World’s AI Developers
claims: NVIDIA DGX Spark Arrives for World’s AI Developers
NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang delivers DGX Spark to Elon Musk at SpaceX.
This week, NVIDIA and its partners are shipping DGX Spark, the world’s smallest AI supercomputer, delivering NVIDIA’s AI stack in a compact desktop form factor.
Acer, ASUS, Dell Technologies, GIGABYTE, HPI, Lenovo and MSI debut DGX Spark systems, expanding access to powerful AI computing.

quotes: The name "DGX" has historically applied to NVIDIA's data center systems

The interconnect bandwidth is substantially higher than PCIe, enabling fast model loading and eliminating the split between "system memory" and "GPU memory." The practical result: any model that fits in 128GB can run on DGX Spark at full speed.
